verses.pali: “Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhammā mahapphalā mahānisaṁsā, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these ten things are not very fruitful and beneficial apart from the Holy One’s training.
Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā mahapphalā mahānisaṁsā, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These are the ten things that are not very fruitful and beneficial apart from the Holy One’s training.”
